experiment: first-passage dynamics from a population balanced-Lloyd saddle

protocol.threshold_selection_history: The threshold was informed by an earlier exploratory run and fixed before this follow-up; the study was not preregistered.
protocol.assignment: exact equal-capacity linear assignment using scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment
protocol.stopping: unchanged exact partition on consecutive assignments; maximum 100 iterations
protocol.event: absolute normalized (1,-2,1)/sqrt(6) high-mode amplitude first reaches 0.4 strictly before the returned terminal fixed-point state; the repeat-detection assignment call is one index later than that state
protocol.candidate_prediction: for tau>1/3, first-passage iteration has leading term log(n)/(2*log(3*tau)) if the empirical perturbation remains coherent near the saddle; this is a hypothesis under study
protocol.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for hit fractions; percentile intervals from 5,000 dataset bootstrap resamples for median hit time conditional on a hit

classification_rebuild: Strict preterminal hits and threshold hits exactly at the returned terminal state were classified from saved dataset-level first-hit and repeat-detection indices; raw trajectories were unchanged.
